label: Initial cross-sector oddball census
summary: A first immutable census of recurring structures that survive exact checks but do not yet warrant identification as one shared object.
changes: Introduces a durable observation layer separate from claims, conjectures, and the moving frontier.
Seeds seven recurring motifs with explicit confidence, invariant content, cautions, and bounded discriminating tests.
Makes promotion and dissolution visible rather than silently rewriting earlier interpretations.

observations.name: The relative object survives what the absolute object forgets
observations.observation: Independent calculations repeatedly produce an absolute object that is contractible, oversized, or presentation-dependent while a support-aware or relative object retains the candidate physical information.
observations.invariant_content: Forgetting support, framing, or presentation changes the information carried by the object; a nonzero associated grade alone does not imply a global physical class.
observations.caution: The relative objects have not been proved to be instances of one universal functor.
observations.next_test: Construct the source-derived forget-support comparison in two sectors and test whether the same localization or six-functor identity controls both kernels.

observations.name: The discarded principal cell returns
observations.observation: At several frontiers, retaining only homogeneous kernels produces attractive but mistyped quotients; the labelled principal or affine coherence cell is required to define the source map.
observations.invariant_content: Source labels and coherence data can carry information not recoverable from the reduced kernel or its rank.
observations.caution: The cells differ by complex and should not be identified merely because they repair analogous typing failures.
observations.next_test: State the principal-cell construction functorially in two completed examples and test naturality under the admitted incidence maps.

observations.name: The quartic behaves like transport, not a place
observations.observation: The algebraic quartic repeatedly fails to create carrier rank support, fitting support, or source-rank excess, while remaining compatible with an extension or comparison obstruction. A useful but unproved software analogy is a policy boundary that filters permitted transport without changing the underlying resource store.
observations.invariant_content: On every audited absolute carrier locus, imposing the quartic leaves the relevant rank unchanged.
observations.caution: Negative carrier tests localize the possibility; they do not establish a particular connection or extension class.
observations.next_test: Compute a source-certified relative extension cocycle and test its intrinsic support before naming the quartic as its divisor.

observations.name: The square-root descent gate
observations.observation: Double covers, deck parity, anti-invariant cycles, and even-character square roots recur at otherwise distinct coefficient and readout gates.
observations.invariant_content: In Strominger's diagonal-parity packet, the obstruction character is a square and therefore admits the cocycle square root; analogous sectors carry independently defined Z2 gradings.
observations.caution: A shared Z2 vocabulary is not yet a shared Z2 object, and flavor chart phases are not physical invariants.
observations.next_test: Formulate the parity/descent square in two sectors without choosing coordinates and test whether odd exponent parity obstructs the corresponding construction in both.

observations.name: One line keeps stepping out of the crowd
observations.observation: Independent reductions repeatedly isolate a distinguished one-dimensional candidate before transport, totalization, or physical selection decides whether it survives.
observations.invariant_content: The individual quotient or resonance lines are canonical only within their own typed constructions.
observations.caution: Several such lines have already failed horizontality or physical activation; rank one alone carries almost no cross-sector force.
observations.next_test: Compare the universal property selecting each line, not its dimension; dissolve the oddball if no common property survives coordinate-free formulation.

observations.name: The two sign systems agree only on the magnetic anchor
observations.observation: The gravitational diagonal-character vector (-1,+1,-1) and the declared Carrier vector (+1,+1,+1) agree on exactly one rung, and it is the independently distinguished diagonal-even magnetic anchor.
observations.invariant_content: The magnetic rung is selected independently in the gravitational calculation; the two displayed sign vectors have Hamming distance two.
observations.caution: The agreement may still be forced by conventions or by an unrecorded asymmetry in how the Carrier vector was declared.
observations.next_test: Characterize the magnetic rung without either sign vector, then test whether every admitted comparison must preserve it; dissolve the coincidence if an admitted symmetry moves the agreement point.

observations.name: The rules are transported by the rules
observations.observation: The off-diagonal cocycle governing the infinity-Gysin extension is itself horizontal for the induced Hom connection, suggesting that action-authority data may be coefficient objects governed by the same calculus they hydrate.
observations.invariant_content: Flatness forces nabla_Hom C=0 for the source-adapted extension cocycle C; generic Q=0 is nevertheless regular in this absolute block.
observations.caution: One horizontal extension cocycle does not prove recursive closure of the full action system. The proposed 15-to-41-to-26 target was also untyped: 852 of 5,780 represented branch relations fail descent into the independently truncated union packet.
observations.next_test: Construct one source-labelled branch-and-union localization/deletion complex before quotient or cutoff; derive its chain maps and authority cocycle there, then test self-transport and intrinsic Q support.

evidence.label: Q is regular in the absolute extension
